action_contracts.responsible_role: municipal transport/public-realm delivery lead, jointly reviewed by the rail operator
action_contracts.maintenance_owner: municipal public-realm maintainer coordinated with the rail operator
action_contracts.stop_condition: Stop fixing the alignment if traffic, rail-safety or accessibility review cannot confirm a safe continuous ground route; keep the action HOLD until an equivalent route is demonstrated.
action_contracts.fallback: A professional-approved temporary accessible route must open before the affected segment closes; otherwise the action remains HOLD.
action_contracts.verification_method: day/night/rain route audit with wheelchair user and older-person participation, plus traffic and accessibility professional review

action_contracts.interface_to: municipal sidewalk, bicycle parking, bus/taxi/ride-hailing interfaces
action_contracts.responsible_role: station-area public-realm delivery lead with transport-operations representatives
action_contracts.maintenance_owner: station-area public-realm operator and transport facility maintainers by asset boundary
action_contracts.stop_condition: Stop permanent allocation if observed mode demand, turning paths or emergency access cannot be reconciled without occupying the accessible line.
action_contracts.fallback: Use removable channelization and staffed management while the permanent allocation is corrected.
action_contracts.verification_method: peak/off-peak conflict observation, turning-path review, accessible-route measurement and emergency access check

action_contracts.interface_to: Shunxinyuan entrance and existing park route
action_contracts.responsible_role: park asset owner or authorized public-realm renewal delivery entity
action_contracts.maintenance_owner: park maintainer at the park side and municipal maintainer at the sidewalk side
action_contracts.stop_condition: Kill or reduce the retrofit if it harms trees or drainage, narrows the clear route, causes unsafe glare or lacks an accepted maintenance owner.
action_contracts.fallback: Retain the existing park condition and deliver a smaller removable rest/help element outside the clear route.
action_contracts.verification_method: entrance measurement, rain observation, night audit, tree/drainage review and maintenance trial

action_contracts.responsible_role: renewal/planning delivery lead conditions the interface; the future parcel developer delivers the parcel side
action_contracts.maintenance_owner: future parcel developer/property manager for the parcel side; public maintainer for the exterior bypass
action_contracts.stop_condition: Do not count the shared edge as a required Journey segment unless public rights, hours, fire/accessibility compliance and exterior bypass are secured in binding conditions.
action_contracts.fallback: The exterior public bypass remains the accepted Journey; the shared floor is removed from the required route.
action_contracts.verification_method: planning-condition audit, public/private line review, after-hours tabletop and on-site acceptance after delivery

action_contracts.interface_to: shared ground floor and planned vertical connection layer / IF-DZS-06
action_contracts.responsible_role: future parcel developer and connection-facility delivery entity under joint rail/planning review
action_contracts.maintenance_owner: future property/connection facility operator under a written interface agreement
action_contracts.stop_condition: Keep the link HOLD or kill it if any rail, utility, structure, fire, accessibility or public-access gate fails, or if it weakens the independent ground route.
action_contracts.fallback: Remove the vertical link from the required Journey and keep DZS-A01/DZS-A04 as the public route.
action_contracts.verification_method: multi-professional design review, failure-mode tabletop and joint acceptance before operation

action_contracts.interface_to: future parcel and connection construction boundary
action_contracts.responsible_role: construction entity before occupation, overseen by the approving and receiving public-asset roles
action_contracts.maintenance_owner: construction entity during occupation, with receiving public-asset maintainer identified before handback
action_contracts.stop_condition: Do not close or occupy the original route until the equivalent temporary route is inspected, operating, legible and assigned to a maintainer.
action_contracts.fallback: Do not close the original route; revise the construction phase or sequence.
action_contracts.verification_method: pre-closure walk-through with target users, daily inspection and post-phase restoration acceptance

action_contracts.responsible_role: station-scene project delivery entity with the receiving station-area public-realm maintainer
action_contracts.maintenance_owner: receiving station-area public-realm maintainer after construction handoff
action_contracts.stop_condition: Do not accept the endpoint as Journey-complete if the onward public edge, temporary route or receiving maintenance role remains unverified.
action_contracts.fallback: Keep the current public route and temporary handoff until the receiving interface passes field verification.
action_contracts.verification_method: post-completion route audit and joint boundary walk-through

action_contracts.responsible_role: renewal/planning delivery lead coordinating municipal and blue-green asset roles
action_contracts.maintenance_owner: municipal/blue-green asset maintainers and future renewal public-realm maintainer by boundary
action_contracts.stop_condition: Hold permanent geometry until the public/blue-green boundaries, flood/drainage conditions and receiving maintenance roles are verified.
action_contracts.fallback: Hold permanent construction and retain a protected temporary public route to the verified network.
action_contracts.verification_method: boundary overlay, professional review and post-delivery Journey audit

action_contracts.interface_to: campus/property threshold and building entrance / IF-QH-06
action_contracts.responsible_role: future renewal/property developer with planning and public-realm interface review
action_contracts.maintenance_owner: future property manager with public-realm maintainer at the boundary
action_contracts.stop_condition: Do not count the destination as delivered until the exact entrance, public rights/hours, accessible threshold and receiving owner are confirmed.
action_contracts.fallback: Use the verified public-network endpoint as the Journey terminus until the property interface is delivered.
action_contracts.verification_method: approved-design review and actual entrance/open-hour audit

action_contracts.responsible_role: existing project/asset roles jointly conduct post-delivery Journey re-audit
action_contracts.maintenance_owner: existing station, municipal/project and property maintainers by current asset boundary
action_contracts.stop_condition: Stop new design production while residual failure remains unproven; preserve and re-audit instead.
action_contracts.fallback: Escalate only the confirmed interface to AIO-A02; do not redesign the full route.
action_contracts.verification_method: same six-profile day/night/rain/closure field audit after project delivery

action_contracts.responsible_role: property manager and municipal public-realm delivery role, activated only after a confirmed field failure
action_contracts.maintenance_owner: property manager at the threshold with municipal public-realm maintainer outside
action_contracts.stop_condition: Keep HOLD or KILL the patch when no residual failure is confirmed, when it duplicates the approved project, or when consent/professional review/maintenance acceptance fails.
action_contracts.fallback: KILL the patch and retain AIO-A01 preservation/re-audit only.
action_contracts.verification_method: before/after field observation of the single confirmed interface
